author: harness:claude-code

patch.value: Evolution is unrecorded: one supersedes edge exists across 1799 closed items and 14 releases, so nothing in the graph says which work replaced which

Measured 2026-07-27 from pm graph audit profile.edges_by_kind. The corpus holds 9262 edges. Exactly one of them is supersedes. Two are incident_from. 161 are discovered_from. Against 1799 closed items spanning 14 released versions and roughly two months of dense daily work, that distribution says the tracker has recorded almost no evolution at all. The kinds that exist to express replacement, derivation and causation are the kinds that carry a project through time, and they are the three rarest in the graph while related, a kind with no direction and no semantics, accounts for 4437 edges or 48 percent. The effect is concrete and checkable. This project has repeatedly superseded its own decisions: an ADR is accepted and a later one revises it, a command spelling is consolidated into a noun and the old spelling survives as an alias, an audit surface is extracted into a package and the in-core version is removed, a measurement script is replaced by a canonical one. Every one of those transitions is described in prose inside a resolution or a close reason, and none of them is an edge. A reader can find them only by reading text, which is exactly the cost the graph exists to remove. The same is true of derivation: work discovered while doing other work is the dominant way items are born here, and 161 discovered_from edges cannot account for 2118 items. Retyping is not the whole answer and should not be forced, because a related edge between two items that merely mention each other is honest. The gap is that no evidence pipeline exists to promote the cases where the relationship is stated in durable text into the kind that states it structurally.

Replacement, derivation and causation relationships stated in durable text such as resolutions, close reasons, duplicate closures and history messages are promotable to typed edges by an evidence rule, not by judgement per item; Promotion is auditable: every typed edge created this way records the evidence class that produced it and remains reversible without losing the prior version; A related edge that genuinely carries no direction stays related; the pass never retypes for the sake of the distribution; The typed-kind distribution is a reported governance metric, so a corpus where supersedes is vanishingly rare is a visible condition rather than an unexamined default; Traversal over the promoted kinds answers the question of what replaced what across releases without reading item prose
Recover the projects evolution as typed structure so graph algorithms can trace replacement and derivation lineages across the full history
Superseded work is the largest silent category in a mature tracker; without lineage edges an agent rereads obsolete decisions and cannot tell that a newer one governs
Directly serves the deep-linking requirement: lineage edges are what create long typed chains through terminal history rather than a wide flat rim of associations
The terminal backfill connected the corpus and left related at 48 percent of all edges, which the backfill evidence itself flagged as the bucket to refine rather than a settled default
pm 2026.7.27, this workspace at 2118 items, measured via pm graph audit --summary profile.edges_by_kind
Run pm graph audit --json and read profile.edges_by_kind; compare the supersedes, incident_from and discovered_from counts against by_status.closed from pm stats
A tracker with 1799 closed items over 14 releases records many replacement and derivation relationships as typed edges

message: File the missing lineage semantics found while profiling typed edge distribution

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Evidence 2026-07-27: bounded lineage tranche executed under this item's evidence rules, with the method recorded so it is repeatable and auditable.

Scope. Two edge classes were recovered from durable text only, no inference, no heuristic similarity, no judgement per item. Both are explicit-identifier evidence, which this item's acceptance criteria name as an admissible class.

Class one, supersedes, 39 edges. Extraction required a directional phrase immediately followed by an item identifier, in one of five forms: this item is superseded by X, folded into X, duplicate_of X, and the two forward spellings X supersedes Y and X replaces Y. The overwhelming majority, 32 of 39, come from a single machine-written pattern left by the 2026-04-04 dedupe pass, whose comments read verbatim that this item is superseded by pm-phpq for cluster release-loop::2026-03-07 and equivalents. Every referenced identifier was checked to resolve to an existing item file before any write; zero unresolved references. Corpus effect: supersedes 1 to 40.

Class two, discovered_from, 28 edges. Extraction required one of sixteen derivation phrases within sixty characters of an identifier, the phrase set being discovered while, discovered during, discovered from, found while, surfaced while, filed while, filed from, filed during, split out of, split from, extracted from, carved out of, spun out of, follow-up to, follow-on to and uncovered while. Thirty-one candidates were produced; three were dropped by review because the sentence names the derived item rather than the source, which reverses the edge direction, and fabricating a reversed edge is precisely what this item's criteria forbid. Corpus effect: discovered_from 161 to 187.

Totals. Edges 9262 to 9356 over 2121 nodes. No existing edge was removed or retyped in place; every write is additive and appears in each item's history with a message naming its evidence class, so each is individually reversible and explainable.

What this deliberately did not do. No ordering edges were manufactured. The temptation is real, because the corpus has release cohorts and parent lineages from which a plausible sequence could be derived for hundreds of terminal items, and the resulting graph would look far deeper. That is fabrication under this item's rules and it was not done. The honest state is recorded instead as pm-gxs55a: 88.5 percent of sequenced nodes have no predecessor and the longest path is six hops, which on inspection turn out to be one item and five duplicates of it.

Residual for this item. The extraction rules above are narrow by design and their yield is correspondingly small against 1799 closed items. Widening them is the work, and it needs the human review this item requires, because the next tier of evidence is prose that states a relationship without stating a direction.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Negative result 2026-08-11: the lexical promotion surface this item's evidence rule harvests is exhausted, and the next looser threshold has zero precision.

Method. Over all 2,437 items I gathered description, acceptance criteria, and every comment, note and learning text, extracted every pm identifier mention that resolves to a real item, discarded any pair that already carries an edge in either direction or a parent relation, and required a directional cue immediately before the identifier inside the same sentence. Cue families were supersedes, verifies, discovered_from, blocked_by and incident_from.

At a 170-character cue window the rule proposed 120 edges. Inspection showed the great majority came from narrative roadmap logs, where a cue and an unrelated identifier merely co-occur, so that threshold is unusable.

At the tightest defensible threshold, cue ending immediately before the identifier inside one sentence, with the narrative log items excluded as sources, the rule proposed exactly 8 edges. All 8 are wrong, and all 8 are wrong the same way.

The failure mode is subject misattribution. A cue reliably identifies the relationship kind and its object, which is the identifier following it. It does not identify the subject. In tracker prose the subject is normally a third item the sentence is discussing, not the item whose field holds the text. Concretely:

- three proposed supersedes edges pointing at pm-gxs55a, pm-wmf72c and pm-lnrk came from this item's own evidence comment, which quotes the 2026-04-04 dedupe pass phrasing "this item is superseded by pm-phpq" in order to describe the pattern. The quoting item is not the subject.
- two proposed verifies edges came from a filing summary listing "pm-qapjw5 (verifies pm-w7ccmv), pm-htbetn (verifies pm-xp1xsw)". The subject of each cue is the identifier before it, not the holder.
- one proposed verifies edge came from "pm-lixy gained verifies pm-4k6b", same shape.
- two proposed blocked_by edges came from parenthetical asides whose subject was a catalog entry or a candidate lever, not the holder item.

Precision at the tightest threshold is therefore 0 of 8, and the 39-edge supersedes tranche recorded on this item on 2026-07-27 already took the class where the subject is explicit or is literally "this item".

The specification consequence is concrete and belongs in this item's evidence rule: promotion must extract subject, cue and object as a triple where the subject is either an explicit identifier in the same sentence or an anaphor that resolves to the holder. A rule keyed on cue and object alone cannot be made precise by tightening the window, because the error is grammatical rather than distance-based.

Do not re-run a cue-and-object promotion over item prose on this corpus. The remaining 1,318 terminal items that carry only membership or associative edges do not name their lineage in prose at all, so their lineage has to come from the non-prose sources pm-s5e04g owns: immutable history streams, linked files and tests, and release epochs.
